race.comment: Handy little race. KINGSBURY (3) resumes after a break of 11 weeks. Did win at his only other first-up run when on debut, scoring over 1200m at Pakenham before form tapered off in some handy races. This suits and he can improve again. MAGNARDO (1) is in flying form, a dominant four length winner when last seen over this route. Perhaps a bit more depth now but will lead and take plenty of catching. KING'S CORONATION (2) scored at last run over 1600m at this track and gelded during a break. Trialled well can pick up where he left off despite a long spell. FLYING MEAN (5) finished third last start over 1000m at Sale, beaten 4.5 lengths. Should be cherry-ripe and has the ability to challenge.
